summary: relief-atlas: the manifest of 10,079 disaster-relief, humanitarian-aid and civil-protection mesh items with pre-generated prompts, the cloud and on-device generation pipelines, their self-tests, and the metadata of 125 earlier meshes. AGENTS.md is the operating contract; this index restates its facts for tools.
